title: io.loams.dev.usage.house.storage.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.house.storage.v1` usage event: A House table's stored bytes, daily (a gauge, §63 §8.3). Producer: UsageObserver (House storage round). Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.

namespace.description: The namespace the usage belongs to (its id)
